user.title: Set up iovo|doc
user.description: Enter the credentials created in iovo|doc for Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Update iovo|doc access
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current credentials from iovo|doc.

error.invalid_auth: iovo|doc did not accept the Basic Auth credentials.
error.unsupported: The iovo|doc interface does not support this Home Assistant integration yet.
error.api_error: The iovo|doc request could not be processed.
error.unknown: The connection to iovo|doc could not be established.
error.access_denied: iovo|doc denied access. The Home Assistant log shows whether Basic Auth was actually sent.

menu_option_descriptions.sync: Synchronize this entry once in the selected direction.
menu_option_descriptions.automatic: Choose whether and how this entry is synchronized regularly.
menu_option_descriptions.device_selection: Choose which Home Assistant entities are sent to iovo|doc.
menu_option_descriptions.device_states: Choose whether changes of selected entities are sent to iovo|doc automatically.

sync.title: Synchronize now
sync.description: Start synchronization. Rooms and floors additionally allow choosing a direction.

automatic.title: Automatic synchronization
automatic.description: Choose whether the data should be synchronized regularly.

data_description.auto_sync: Turns regular synchronization on or off.
data_description.sync_direction: Defines the direction in which changes are transferred.
data_description.conflict_priority: Defines which side wins if the same data was changed on both sides.

device_selection.title: Device selection
device_selection.description: Choose the entities that are sent from Home Assistant to iovo|doc. Exclusions always take precedence.

data_description.device_selection_mode: Choose all supported entities, types, individual entities, or a combination.
data_description.device_types: All automatically recognized entities of these iovo device types are included.
data_description.device_entities: These entities are included additionally or exclusively depending on the selection.

device_states.title: State changes
device_states.description: Master data is sent only during a manual device synchronization. Optionally, changes to selected entities can then be sent to iovo|doc automatically.

data_description.device_state_sync: Automatically transfers state changes and approved additional values of selected entities to iovo|doc.

error.invalid_auth: iovo|doc did not accept the Basic Auth credentials.
error.api_error: The iovo|doc request could not be processed.
error.access_denied: iovo|doc denied access. The Home Assistant log shows whether Basic Auth was actually sent.

restart_required.title: Home Assistant restart required
restart_required.description: iovo|doc was updated from version {loaded_version} to {installed_version}. Restart Home Assistant completely so the new integration version is loaded.
